summary: Kipushi territory (Haut-Katanga), a copper-mining area on the Zambian border just west and south of Lubumbashi, has no territorial armed-group presence. The state controls the whole unit: the PNC keeps order in Kipushi town and in the peri-urban neighbourhoods on the edge of Lubumbashi, with FARDC and border services present along the Zambian frontier. Insecurity is criminal: armed robbery and killings in Kipushi town (e.g. the murder of a court defender on 30-31 Dec 2025 that triggered protests and a provincial response). Bakata Katanga militia activity in 2024-2025 was concentrated in northern Haut-Katanga and Haut-Lomami (Pweto, Mitwaba, Bukama, Malemba-Nkulu), not in Kipushi. The rural villages of Kafubu and Kipushi secteurs are assessed as default state (PNC) presence.

zones.description: Kipushi town (cité minière, territory HQ, Zambian border)
zones.evidence: Territory HQ under full state administration; insecurity is criminal (armed men killed a court defender and others on 30-31 Dec 2025), prompting protests and a visit by the provincial interior minister promising police action. No armed group holds any part of the town.

zones.description: Southwestern edge neighbourhoods of Lubumbashi falling in Kipushi territory (Kampemba health zone: Kasapa 2, Iringi, Mulao, La Voix, Kasombo, Mille Collines, Maisha, etc.)
zones.evidence: Part of the Lubumbashi urban area, policed by the PNC (Operation Ndobo since April 2025) with joint FARDC-PNC cordon-and-search operations against bandits in 2025-2026; no gang or militia holds territory.

zones.description: Rural villages and mining localities of Kipushi and Kafubu secteurs (Sokoto, Tondolo, Kasangula/Lumata, Kakana, Maksemu, Kinsevere area, Mulapwa, etc.)
zones.evidence: No reported armed-group activity in Kipushi territory; Bakata Katanga and Twa militia incidents in 2024-2026 were in northern Haut-Katanga/Haut-Lomami. Order assumed kept by PNC posts and customary chiefs, with FARDC/border services along the Zambian frontier.
